UUID Java oracle fixtures are generated by `dev/GenerateIcebergUuidOracle.java`.
From the repository root, run the following with both JDK 17 and JDK 21, using
separate output directories and comparing both files before replacing the fixtures:

```sh
java dev/GenerateIcebergUuidOracle.java /tmp/uuid-oracle
```

The checked-in files matched byte for byte on Homebrew 17.0.20+0 and Oracle
Corporation 21.0.12+7-LTS-205. The generator prints the vendor and exact runtime
version on stderr. `uuid-java.tsv` records UTF-8 input bytes in hex and either the
16 big-endian UUID bytes in hex or `error`. It includes fixed edge cases and
mutations seeded with 6959. `uuid-java-digits.tsv` records every BMP code unit for
which `Character.digit(char, 16)` succeeds; the Rust test also checks rejection
of every other BMP scalar. Supplementary-plane digits are rejected because Java
parses each UTF-16 code unit independently.
